type:
∀ (n : NativeBridge.MN) (x : NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.Word),
  NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.zTo
      (Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.Cyclic.Int63.Uint63Axioms.to_Z_rec (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Datatypes.nat.S n) x) =
    if NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.isEven x = true then
      2 *
        NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.zTo
          (Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.Cyclic.Int63.Uint63Axioms.to_Z_rec n
            (Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.Cyclic.Int63.PrimInt63.lsr x 1#63))
    else
      2 *
          NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.zTo
            (Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.Cyclic.Int63.Uint63Axioms.to_Z_rec n
              (Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.Cyclic.Int63.PrimInt63.lsr x 1#63)) +
        1
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.StringUnsignedSupport.toZRec_succ

        Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.BinNums.Z → Rocq.Corelib.Numbers.BinNums.Z) Rocq.Corelib.BinNums.IntDef.Z.double
        Rocq.Corelib.BinNums.IntDef.Z.succ_double b z) =
